notes: Example shift_req.json showcasing all currently supported features. Comments are provided via 'notes' fields to remain valid JSON.

cases.notes: Basic case using current week (week_date=null). Uses k=3 and days mapping only; no backup_strategy.
Overrides the target week using case-level week_date. Adds a specific date with custom ranges. Also enables forced relax backup_strategy to enumerate more candidates.
Any day with more than two ranges will auto-bump allowed k to 4 internally. This demonstrates the special-case policy.
